admission.justification: Realized across cli/held_reset_adoption.py, cli/held_reset_delivery.py, and cli/paseo_role_tools.py, and guarded by aged-wait adoption and live-entry precedence proofs in mcp/tests/test_held_reset_delivery.py.

applicability: Dashboard startup whenever live launch receipts reference held stores containing waiting rows with non-null limitedUntil timestamps.
conditions: adopt_held_resets walks all live receipt_roots in bounded 32-path chunks, selects the earliest limitedUntil from complete read_waiting_rows results, and calls HeldResetIndex.enroll.
Enrollment uses ON CONFLICT(agent) DO NOTHING so live scheduled reset generations always win over startup adoption.
Aged waits that have left the 24-hour / 512-entry held-receipt queue are still adopted and delivered at reset.
exclusions: Unreadable receipts, mismatched store endpoints, and incomplete waiting-row reads are skipped without aborting startup adoption.
statement: The dashboard start enrolls each recipient's existing provider-limited holds into the reset index before the next due pass.
title: Startup adoption of saved provider-limited held waits
